answer: Template copies forfeit a posted bond. Each key posts an umber of 18 POA before its answer can be settled. Each epoch the beacon publishes the fingerprint method and the similarity threshold, and the key files a raven — the fingerprint of its answer text. If a later raven falls inside that threshold of an earlier one, the later key's umber burns. Four hundred twenty keys that reuse one template produce one distinct raven, so 419 keys each burn 18 POA: 419 x 18 = 7,542 POA the attacker forfeits.
